title: Zoning map change for 50-20 108th Street, Corona, Queens
summary: This resolution approves a City Planning Commission decision to amend the zoning map, changing R6B and R6B/C2-3 districts to R7A and R7A/C2-4 districts at 50-20 108th Street in Corona, Queens Community District 4. The change would help enable two mixed-use buildings totaling about 216,400 square feet with 196 apartments, including 51 income-restricted units. It is linked to a related zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area.
